rule: JS/TS function types through a type alias. Function-type evidence covers a type alias whose definition is a function type, generic or not. The alias can be declared in the file, or imported and re-exported.
source: SPEC Decisions (2026-11-10, amendment): vue runtime-test render
notes: baseRender is destructured from a call, so the Alias rule does not resolve render; the cast's type decides. RootRenderFunction<string> is a generic alias of a function type, imported through the re-export in runtime-core/index.ts: function-type evidence, mod.render direct medium. Plain is a local alias of a function type (half). Box aliases an object type: no evidence, callback unknown. createRenderer resolves through the re-export to its scanned definition, high. Index files are named by their directory.
